  historiae integritati sufficienti
Creator: Jeronimo Nadal (1507-1580)
Publisher: (imprint not independently confirmed from the fetched
  metadata this session), 1595
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: 1595 publication date places this well out of US
  copyright (431 years before this session, 2026); no explicit
  archive.org copyright-status field present on this item, so the
  determination rests on the stated publication date alone, per this
  project's standing PD-by-date rule.
Language: lat
Source: Internet Archive item adnotationesetme00nada

Content note: This is the Latin original of Nadal's own Gospel
  annotations and meditations - a major first-generation Jesuit
  theological voice. The only English translation this world's own
  dossier could locate (Frederick Homann, S.J., Saint Joseph's Univ.
  Press, 2003) is in copyright and print-disabled/restricted; per this
  project's own second-witness rule (cic/texts/INTAKE.md), this file is
  PRIMARY content for this world, not a second witness, since no English
  rendering of this work currently exists in this corpus.
Provenance note: OCR QUALITY FLAG, disclosed plainly: the opening
  matter (title page, likely a decorative engraved frontispiece) is
  severely OCR-garbled. Spot-checked well into the body (line ~3000)
  and found clean, readable period Latin prose there. Every quotation
  must be independently re-checked character-by-character against this
  file before use. Body text otherwise unaltered including its own OCR
  errors.
